context: A marketing meeting on a new product positioning
purpose: Teach: 主旨/担い/抱え/仕方/推進/占める/認知/自社

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今日の会議の主旨は、自社ブランドの新しい立ち位置を決めることだ。
lines.en: The point of today's meeting is to decide our company brand's new positioning.
lines.style: Authoritative middle-aged male executive opening a meeting firmly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、現状の認知度調査では、若年層がほぼ半分を占めるという結果でした。
lines.en: Yes, in the current brand awareness survey, the young demographic makes up almost half.
lines.style: Polite professional female office worker presenting data clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。では推進すべき方向は、その層をさらに深く掘り下げることだな。
lines.en: I see. So the direction we should push is digging deeper into that demographic.
lines.style: Decisive male manager thinking aloud with confident pacing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ただ、競合も同じ層を抱えていて、差別化がうまくいかないのが悩みです。
lines.en: However, competitors are also targeting the same group, so differentiation isn't going well.
lines.style: Thoughtful female employee voicing a concern with measured tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 仕方ないとは言え、ここで諦めるわけにはいかない。誰がこの企画を担いたい?
lines.en: It can't be helped, but we can't give up here. Who wants to take on this project?
lines.style: Firm but encouraging male boss challenging the team directly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私がやらせていただきます。この三か月、ずっとデータを見続けてきましたので。
lines.en: Please let me do it. I've been watching the data for three months straight.
lines.style: Determined female worker volunteering with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼もしいな。君のような若手が中心的な役割を占めるのが、これからの会社だ。
lines.en: Reliable. A company where young talent like you plays a central role is our future.
lines.style: Warm but commanding male executive offering rare praise.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。来週までに具体的な推進プランをまとめてご提出します。
lines.en: Thank you very much. I will compile a concrete implementation plan by next week.
lines.style: Grateful professional female closing with crisp commitment.
